title: The corn stalks
logline: The stalks from September's corn dried and tied to Gully's ramp rail, October, the way the shack has done since Maria started it. The page doesn't know when that was. Neither does Gully.

panels.composition: Dried corn stalks tied to the rail of a plank ramp at a shingle shack's door, October light, the dock beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, dried corn stalks tied to the rail of a plank ramp at a shingle shack's door in October light with a dock beyond, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Since Maria started it. When: nobody knows.
